blocks.text: Managing your interview workspace on Mac

As a recruitment coordinator, your Mac is your command center. You likely have an Applicant Tracking System, LinkedIn Recruiter, and a calendar open at all times. Adding Zoom to this mix often leads to window clutter. To stay focused, use Stage Manager or create dedicated Spaces for your interview blocks.

When you are in a meeting, your screen is your primary tool for sharing scorecards or job descriptions. If you struggle to find the right menu item, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a setting is. Lazur will circle the button on your screen, saving you from digging through menus while a candidate waits.
Essential Zoom keyboard shortcuts for recruiters

items: ⌘ ⇧ A: Mute or unmute your audio quickly.
⌘ ⇧ V: Start or stop your video feed.
⌘ ⇧ S: Open the screen sharing window.
⌘ ⇧ H: Show or hide the meeting chat panel.
⌘ ⇧ W: Switch to gallery view to see all interviewers.

blocks.text: Memorizing these shortcuts prevents you from fumbling with your trackpad. If you forget one, ask Lazur to remind you of the shortcut for a specific action. This keeps your eyes on the candidate rather than the interface.

The scheduling tax is the time you lose to back and forth emails. It accounts for nearly half of your workday. Use tools like Calendly integrated with Zoom to automate the link generation process. When you need to send a manual invite, use Lazur to draft the message template at your cursor. This ensures your tone remains professional and consistent across every candidate interaction.
If you find yourself repeatedly typing the same meeting instructions, save them as a snippet in Lazur. Press fn to dictate the snippet directly into your email or ATS field.
blocks.title: Save time on repetitive emails

blocks.text: Technical issues are the enemy of a good candidate experience. If your screen share shows a black screen, it is usually a permissions issue. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording and ensure Zoom is toggled on. If you are in a rush, ask Lazur to guide you to the correct settings panel.

Always check your camera and microphone inputs before the day begins. Zoom sometimes defaults to the wrong device if you have recently unplugged a headset. You can test these in Zoom > Settings > Audio and Video. If you need to switch devices mid-call, click the arrow next to the microphone icon in the bottom left corner of the meeting window.
Maintaining focus during back to back sessions

Back to back interviews lead to fatigue. Use a physical timer or a simple Mac app to track your time. When a meeting ends, use Lazur to quickly log your notes into your ATS. Dictate your thoughts immediately while they are fresh. This prevents the end of day catch up that often leads to errors.

items: Forgetting to enable the waiting room for candidate privacy.
Leaving sensitive browser tabs open while sharing your screen.
Using a low battery level that causes Zoom to throttle your video quality.
Failing to update the Zoom client, which can lead to compatibility issues with newer macOS versions.
Trying to manage too many windows, leading to missed notifications from candidates.

blocks.text: To avoid sharing the wrong window, use the specific window sharing option in Zoom rather than sharing your entire desktop. This protects your privacy and keeps your candidate focused on the presentation.
What to do when Zoom acts up

If Zoom becomes unresponsive, force quit the app using ⌘ ⌥ ⎋. Select Zoom from the list and click Force Quit. Reopen it immediately. If problems persist, check your internet connection. A wired connection is always more stable than Wi-Fi for high stakes interviews.
Optimizing your Mac for long term performance

Keep your macOS updated to at least the version recommended by Zoom. Newer versions of macOS often include security patches that affect how apps access your camera and microphone. If you notice your fan running loud, close background apps that consume high CPU, such as heavy browser extensions or cloud sync services.

faq.question: How can I quickly find a setting in Zoom while on a call?
faq.answer: Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where the setting is. Lazur will point to the specific menu item or button on your screen.

faq.question: Why does my screen share show a black screen?
faq.answer: This is usually a macOS permissions issue. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording and grant Zoom access.

faq.question: How do I stop spending so much time on scheduling?
faq.answer: Use automated tools like Calendly and use Lazur to quickly draft and format your candidate email communications.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Zoom?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It guides you by pointing to the right spot or explaining the steps.
